title: Dragonkin!
content: Well first I was on a yacht with familiar faces, near a coast where there were mansions. My kid hood friend and I went to the mall together for some reason. There, they came out to me that they transitioned and they were now something non-human, and they informed me all the people on the yacht did the same thing. It was just them and me in a retail space converted into a bedroom, and we were just catching up. Then the power in the mall went out. We then were surrounded by what I'm finding out are Dragonkin, an ancient race of people that descended from dragons, a race that's dotted the cosmos for hundreds of millions of years. They were there for my friend who I guess was manipulating some sort of dream-world authority figure. The Dragonkin informed me that I had a bunch of money and precious minerals but my brother stole it all from me. My brother claimed the stuff belonged to him because he has darker hair, and kept showing his hair to everyone. I was upset so I broke a terrarium that was in his room, and a bunch of little creatures came flying out. Seeing terrariums and opening them up and creatures flying out is a common theme in my dreams. Just a couple nights ago I was dreaming of walking through a park and seeing a random set of aquariums and feeling so bad for the lizards inside so I released them. And there's usually something to do with Canada when these things happen. I've been researching near death experiences lately, and there's a lot of people claiming insectoid creatures are apart of those experiences. The leader of the Dragonkin, Andy, informed me that the NDE's these people are experiencing are more or less a simulation and not an authentic spirtual experience. In waking life I entertain myself with fringe content, but I don't take the conspiracy theories too seriously, and have always been a skeptic. But this Andy fella has me hooked. I don't know much about dragons but I think it's time for me to do some research.
